primitives.note: Q is a delayed-detonation nuke cast on the dummy's location on (near-)zero cooldown; R is a global-range channeled nuke on a long cooldown
Requiem channels for 3s before dealing damage; other spellcasts are blocked during the channel
Defile is a toggled aura dealing magic damage per tick to nearby enemies, recalculated each tick from current AP/rank
Defile drains mana per second and auto-toggles off if Karthus cannot pay the cost, capping how long the DoT can run in the 15s window; Q/W/R mana costs are comparatively minor
Wall of Pain applies a 25% magic resistance reduction (plus a slow, ignored) to any enemy that touches it, once per cast, for 5s

Q's damage is doubled and applies as single-target spell damage whenever only one enemy is struck, which is always true against a single dummy; W is a line skillshot perpendicular to Karthus's facing and needs an assumption that it reliably touches the stationary dummy

Death Defied triggers on Karthus's own death, granting 7s of untargetability/damage immunity and free casting; relevant only to the survival fight, and only if Karthus is the one being attacked, not in the damage-dealer role against a stationary dummy

needsBespoke.why: Every damage-relevant mechanic (Q's doubled single-target nuke, W's MR shred, E's toggled DoT gated by mana, R's channeled global nuke, P's post-death immunity window) is expressible with plain-cast, dot, target-debuff, resource-budget, charge-or-channel, positional-assumption and defensive-only; nothing requires novel logic outside that list.

unsettled.question: What is Lay Waste's real cooldown: the bin's per-rank array of 0, or the wiki's stated flat 1s?
options: Bin is authoritative: Q has 0 cooldown and is limited only by its 0.25s cast time (near-continuous spam)
Wiki is authoritative: Q has a flat 1s cooldown at all ranks

unsettled.question: Does Defile actually tick every 0.25s (as its per-tick damage formula and wiki description2 imply) or every 0.5s (the ddragon-level cooldown field on the E slot)?
options: Ticks every 0.25s, matching the wiki's stated tick rate and the TotalDPS*0.25 per-tick formula
Ticks every 0.5s per the ddragon cooldown field, with the *0.25 factor being an unrelated tooltip artifact
quotes: deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all nearby enemies

unsettled.question: How long is the delay between casting Lay Waste and its detonation dealing damage?
options: A fixed ~0.5-0.75s delay as noted by the wiki (with acknowledged inconsistency)
Effectively immediate for simulation purposes, since the exact delay is stated to be inconsistent and VFX-driven
quotes: conjures a blast at the target location that detonates after {{tt|{{rutngt|0.5}}{{minus}}{{rutngt|0.75}}|See notes}}
The delay between the cast and the detonation is inconsistent, but always matches up with the VFX.{{bug}}

proposal: Level Q first (max order roughly Q > E > W, taking R at 6/11/16) so Lay Waste is at max rank as early as possible.
At the start of the fight, toggle Defile (E) on so its DoT begins ticking immediately and continues for the whole fight while mana allows.
Cast Wall of Pain (W) once, immediately, centered so its line crosses the dummy's position, applying the 25% MR shred (and slow, which does not matter here) for its full 5s duration.

Cast Requiem (R) once near the start of the fight for its unconditional AP-scaling nuke, accepting the 3s channel during which no other ability can be cast (Defile's already-active toggle keeps ticking through it).
Cast Lay Waste (Q) on the dummy's location on cooldown for the rest of the fight, always landing as a single-target hit and therefore always doubled.

Recast Wall of Pain again if its 15s cooldown comes back up before the fight ends (unlikely within 15s given the opening sequence), otherwise let Q spam and the Defile DoT carry the remainder of the fight.

If mana runs out, Defile is expected to auto-toggle off; prioritize keeping enough mana for continued Q casts over keeping Defile on, since Q's burst-on-cooldown likely outperforms losing all E value versus a fully mana-starved late fight.
questions: At the assumed level/items for the damage fight, does Karthus have enough mana to sustain Defile toggled on for the full 15s while also casting Q on cooldown, W once, and R once, or does Defile need to be cut off partway through?

Is it better to cast Requiem first (accepting the 3s channel lockout early) or last (after Q/E have already been ticking, so the channel doesn't compete with early burst), given cdstart is on-cast and its cooldown far exceeds the 15s fight anyway?

Given Wall of Pain is a line skillshot perpendicular to Karthus's facing rather than a targeted ability, what geometry should the simulator assume so it reliably touches a single stationary dummy exactly once?
Does Requiem's channel block Karthus's auto-attacks/spellcasts only, or does it also pause the already-toggled Defile DoT's ticking (i.e., does the aura's damage continue during the 3s channel)?
